voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.24 s, atempo 1.06

lines.text: Sa Malinta, may sandaling pinapapatay ang lahat ng ilaw.
lines.beat_before: hook: a lateral, six beams on the concrete; they go out one by one

lines.text: Corregidor. Itinayo ang tunnel na ito laban sa bomba. Noong 1942, naging ospital ito ng mga sugatang Pilipino at Amerikano.
lines.beat_before: the island at night, the tunnel mouth; cicadas; then (mid-line) the main tunnel, bed bolts in the floor

lines.text: Noong 1945, may mga sundalong Hapon na nakulong sa loob, at may mga pagsabog. May mga lagusang gumuho na hindi na binuksan.
lines.beat_before: a lateral sealed by rubble; dust trickles down in a beam

lines.text: Sa night tour, may isang hiling ang gabay.
lines.beat_before: the guide ahead turns and lifts a hand; the beams gather on him
the group from behind, six beams

lines.text: Pagbukas ng ilaw, pareho pa rin kami. Halos.
lines.beat_before: the beams go out one by one (1.4 s); then about seven and a half seconds of black: after-images, a dim glow where no one stands

lines.text: Nagbilang ang gabay. Anim kami. Pito ang sumagot.
lines.beat_before: a beam finds, at the back of the group, an extra figure in an old helmet, head bowed; the lights die by themselves; the guide's beam comes back

lines.text: Para sa lahat ng namatay rito, sa lahat ng panig. Huwag natin silang kalimutan.
lines.beat_before: the guide's beam counting heads: six, and a seventh
